parent_objective: run the action-divergent candidate exporter on the M1161 outcome artifacts
blocked_by: M1174 implements exporter tooling and focused tests
invalidates: relocation replay before candidate export audit

public_gates: M1175 may run only the M1174 exporter command
M1175 must not run relocation replay
M1175 must not train actor weights
M1175 must not use private holdout
M1175 must not convert rows into a proof corpus
forbidden_shortcuts: do not convert rows into a proof corpus
do not manually edit candidate CSVs

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: exports a deterministic action-divergent candidate CSV for later bounded relocation replay
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: export artifact only; no replay, mining, PPO, private holdout, promotion, or driver capability claim
stop_condition: stop if selection fails source-diversity gates
stop if selected candidates collapse to old physical pairs
stop if exporter writes malformed artifacts
fallback_plan: if export passes, route to export audit or bounded relocation replay design
if export fails diversity, revise export scoring or route to new mining
if tooling fails, repair exporter before any replay

admission_evidence: M1173 defines explicit export thresholds and diversity gates
export must be audited before replay
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review artifacts

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1175 exports candidates only and adds no self-ID evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1175 adds no replay or training evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If export diversity fails, route to export scoring repair or new mining rather than replaying a weak candidate set.
allowed_claims: no self-identification, driver capability, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-level claim

hypothesis: The M1174 exporter will produce a source-diverse action-divergent candidate CSV from M1161 outcome rows under the M1173 gates.
success_criteria: no replay, mining, actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, conversion, or actor-input change occurs
failure_criteria: export collapses to old two-pair surface
replay, mining, actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, conversion, or actor-input change starts
decision_rule: M1175 may only run the candidate exporter and document the export. It cannot run relocation replay, run mining, train actor weights, run PPO, promote, use private holdout, change actor inputs, or convert rows into a proof corpus.
